# wanix Provider

Manages SD-WAN Instance custom resources in Kubernetes without server-side apply patches.

## Example Usage

```terraform
terraform {
  required_providers {
    wanix = {
      source = "Indexyz/wanix"
    }
  }
}

provider "wanix" {
  config_path = pathexpand("~/.kube/config")
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `client_certificate` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client certificate used with host.
- `client_key` (String, Sensitive) PEM-encoded client private key used with host.
- `cluster_ca_certificate` (String) PEM-encoded cluster CA certificate used with host.
- `config_context` (String) Kubeconfig context to use. Defaults to the current context.
- `config_path` (String) Path to a kubeconfig file. When no connection mode is configured, uses KUBECONFIG or ~/.kube/config.
- `host` (String) Kubernetes API server URL. When set, uses the explicit credentials below instead of kubeconfig.
- `in_cluster_config` (Boolean) Use the pod's service account credentials. Cannot be combined with host, config_path, or config_context.
- `kubeconfig_base64` (String, Sensitive) Base64-encoded kubeconfig loaded in memory. Cannot be combined with config_path, host, or in_cluster_config. Supports config_context. Prefer embedded certificate and key data over file references.
- `token` (String, Sensitive) Bearer token used with host.
